name: dataflow-studio
description: Open-source control plane for data workflows: visual DAG design, durable execution, data quality, lineage and observability.

scripts.build: pnpm -r --filter "./packages/*" run build && pnpm --filter @dataflow-studio/cli run build && pnpm --filter @dataflow-studio/worker run build && pnpm --filter @dataflow-studio/web run build
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules packages/*/dist apps/*/dist apps/web/.next && pnpm store prune || true
